Elegant Christmas arch design: Featuring a graceful arch shape, this Christmas tree creates an inviting entrance that instantly adds warmth and festive charm, elevating any space and immersing you in the festive spirit.

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its green finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Colour: Green. Quantity: 1 piece.
Adds festive detail to your Christmas display with a classic green finish.
Easy to coordinate with surrounding settings and other holiday accessories.
Designed as a focal point to draw attention to your chosen arrangement.
Flexible decorative accessory that can be moved to refresh your display.

Bring festive magic into your home with this beautiful 6ft (180cm) Deluxe Green Artificial Christmas Tree, featuring 200 integrated warm white LED lights for a cosy and welcoming Christmas atmosphere.

Its realistic, bushy green branches create a traditional Christmas look, providing plenty of space for your favourite baubles, ribbons and decorations.

FAQs
What sizes are available?
Available in two heights — 6ft and 7.5ft — so you can choose the best size for your space.

Does it need assembly?
Minimal assembly required. Unfold the branches and attach the tree to its stand. Sections connect via built-in power sockets, so lights link up automatically. A few bolts are hand-tightened — no power tools needed.

Can I change the lighting effects?
Yes — 16 modes via the included remote, covering steady, slow-fade and twinkle effects in warm white, multicolour and pastel, plus colour-flip transitions and a demo mode.

How are the lights powered?
The tree is mains-powered — simply plug in. The remote runs on a button cell battery (not included).

Is it suitable for outdoor use?
Designed for indoor use only. Display in a dry, sheltered location.

Is it covered by a warranty?
Yes. Both sizes come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty.

How is it delivered?
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery.

Safety Information
For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries and small parts away from children/pets. Button cell battery (not included) can cause serious injury if swallowed — seek immediate medical attention. Keep compartment closed.

This Grand Fir Christmas tree comes pre-lit with 500 warm white LEDs and woven through the branches on green cables that blend seamlessly into the foliage. With 1,733 branch tips combining pointed and rounded needle shapes, the tree delivers a naturally textured, forest-like look that's full from every angle. Pointed tips mimic the sharp, spiky needles of a wild pine, while rounded tips bring the soft, fluffy fullness of a spruce. With 1,733 tips packed in, it's dense from top to bottom, just rich green texture that actually looks like it belongs in a forest.
Built to Last: Made from high-quality PE and PVC materials, this tree holds its colour and form year after year. The durable needles bounce back to shape even after storage, it looks as full and fresh on its next Christmas as it does on its first.
Heavy-Duty Steel Stand: Built with a 32mm thick steel centre pole and a 55cm 5-leg metal base, this tree stands firm even when fully loaded with decorations.
Effortless Assembly and Storage: This tree features a clever 3-section, plug-in design – simply stack the three pre-labelled sections (bottom, middle, top) one by one, no tools required. When the festive season ends, the sections pull apart easily, taking up minimal space in storage. Ready to use again for many Christmases to come.

4313817037562.sourceDescription:
Add timeless British festive charm to your dining space with this red-green tartan tablecloth. Blending classic traditional pattern with modern home decor, it brings warm countryside Christmas vibes to every meal. Crafted from premium brushed cotton-polyester
 blend, it is soft, breathable, long-lasting and easy to care for, ideal for holiday dinners, gatherings and gifting.

Features & benefits

Classic British Tartan Design
Inspired by iconic British tartan, this tablecloth adopts traditional red and green Christmas colour palette. The heritage pattern merges classic and contemporary styles, turning every dinner into a cosy English countryside festive feast.

Premium Brushed Cotton & Polyester Fabric
Made of high-quality brushed cotton blended with polyester fibres. Eco-friendly, naturally antibacterial, breathable and luxuriously soft. Polyester enhances fabric durability, keeps colours bright and stands up to regular long-term use.

High-Temperature Dyeing for Excellent Colour Fastness
Adopts professional high-temperature dyeing craft to lock in pattern colours firmly. Boasts outstanding fade resistance, great texture and extended service life, delivering lasting visual appeal for your table setting.

Multi-Occasion Festive Decor & Perfect Gift
Classic red-green Christmas tones full of holiday cheer. Great for family Christmas dinners, seasonal parties, restaurant and café decoration. Also works as a thoughtful festive gift to share warmth and blessings with family and friends.

Simple Care Instructions
Suitable for hand wash or gentle machine wash with mild detergent. Avoid strong bleach to preserve the fabric look. Smooth wrinkles easily with a low-temperature iron.
Design Inspiration: This tablecloth is inspired by the classic British tartan pattern. The tartan symbolizes British traditional culture and long history, exuding a rich British charm. By using traditional red and green colors and tartan patterns, this tablecloth perfectly combines classical and modern elements, making every meal feel like a festive feast in the English countryside.
High-Quality Materials: Made from premium brushed cotton and polyester fibers, this tablecloth is not only eco-friendly but also highly durable. The linen fabric is naturally antibacterial, breathable, and soft to the touch, providing a comfortable user experience. The polyester fibers add durability and make the tablecloth easy to clean, ensuring it remains vibrant even with long-term use.
Exquisite Craftsmanship:The unique high-temperature dyeing process ensures the colors of the pattern, guaranteeing high durability and colorfastness, enhancing the overall decorative effect. This process not only gives the tablecloth a special feel but also extends its lifespan, elevating your taste. This level of craftsmanship provides visual enjoyment and quality assurance.
Versatile Usage:This tablecloth features traditional Christmas colors of red and green, full of festive spirit and suitable for a variety of settings. Whether for family Christmas dinners, holiday gatherings, or decorating restaurants and cafes, it creates a warm and joyful atmosphere. Additionally, it makes an ideal gift for friends and loved ones, conveying the warmth and blessings of the season and making every holiday moment even more memorable.
Care Instructions:We recommend hand washing or machine washing the tablecloth using a mild detergent. Avoid using strong bleach to maintain the tablecloth's long-term beauty. If there are wrinkles, use a low-temperature iron to smooth them out.

5059574924262.sourceDescription:
Crochet Christmas Decorations
These crochet Christmas decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red and green finish and polyester construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Woven Texture
The woven construction gives the surface a structured textile pattern. Its visible texture adds detail to the overall appearance.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Polyester. Colour: Red and Green. Product measurements: length 17 cm, width 15 cm, height 4 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Handcrafted crochet design with a structured woven texture for added visual detail.
Classic festive red and green colour scheme perfect for Christmas tree ornaments.
Durable polyester construction ensures longevity and maintains its shape over time.
Compact dimensions of 17 cm x 15 cm allow for versatile placement on any display.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 1 piece

Product Description

 This black-shell Christmas projection lamp is a wonderful indoor festive decor light with 16 holiday pattern combinations.
 It adopts high-quality compound eye lens and built-in rotating motor, delivering smooth, dynamic rotating projection with bright colourful graphics. 
 The 360-degree rotatable bracket and portable handle bring great installation flexibility. 
 The USB power supply makes it super convenient to use anywhere indoors. 
 Heat dissipation structure effectively prevents overheating during continuous use.
 Light up your Christmas party, family night and holiday celebration with this projector, and create an immersive warm festive atmosphere.

Specifications

 Shell Color: Black
 Light Source: LED
 Power Supply: USB 5V
 Patterns: 16 holiday pattern combinations
 Function: Dynamic rotating projection
 Lens: Compound eye lens
 Size: 9.3 cm / 3.66 in (L) × 7.6 cm / 2.99 in (D), total height 10.5 cm / 4.13 in

Notes

 This projector is for indoor use only, not waterproof.
 Projection clarity changes with distance; the proper distance delivers the best visual effect.
 Keep the lens surface clean to avoid blurry patterns.
Colorful Christmas Projector Light: This snowflake projector automatically displays dynamic moving patterns that brings 16 festive patterns together in one scene—snowflakes, Santa, Christmas tree, and so on. No settings or swapping needed: just plug in and your wall or ceiling becomes a magical Christmas light show.
Vivid HD Projector Lamp: Premium LED beads deliver bright, high-definition projections that bring every snowflake and holiday detail to life. The advanced HD lens casts crisp, colorful imagery on walls or ceilings, creating an immersive atmosphere that entertains both kids and adults during the festivities
USB Powered & Safe to Use: Designed for simple plug-and-play use, this USB-powered projector connects to any 5V/1A source—power banks, laptops, car ports, or wall adapters. No batteries, no tools and no complicated wiring: enjoy plug-and-play Christmas lights in your living room, bedroom, porch or party space in seconds.
Compact & Portable Build: The mini body with a carry handle sits neatly on tabletops, shelves or dashboards, while the adjustable projection angle lets you aim the light wherever you want.Take it anywhere for indoor or outdoor use, from cozy bedtime storytelling to lively party decorations, and store it effortlessly after the season
Instant Holiday Atmosphere & Idear Gift: A lovely home decor addition for Christmas, New Year, Halloween or birthday parties, this projection lamp sets a cozy festive mood in seconds. It makes a thoughtful Christmas gift for kids, families and friends who love decorating for the holidays.

4313817026962.sourceDescription:
Bring Santa's sleigh, six reindeer and a forest village into your Christmas decorating. Black silhouettes and coloured backlighting bring out the shapes of the antlers, trees, rooftops and windows. Use the included remote control to select a light colour
 that complements your setting.
The set features ten separate lamps, and the forest sections can be positioned individually within your arrangement. Create a scene above a sideboard or across a clear indoor wall, leaving the surface below available for other decorations.
Product Details
Product type: decorative Christmas wall lighting
Design: Santa in a sleigh, 6 reindeer and a forest village
Upper arrangement width: 105 cm / 41.34 in
Forest scene width: 80 cm / 31.50 in
Lighting: 10 separate lamps
Light colour: adjustable
Operation: remote control
Layout: forest sections can be positioned separately
Intended setting: indoor decorative displays
Package Contents
1 decoration set featuring Santa in a sleigh, 6 reindeer and forest/village motifs
10 separate lamps
1 remote control
Please Note
Measure your available wall space before arranging the decoration. The total display size depends on the spacing you choose. Follow the instructions supplied with the product. Use in a dry indoor setting away from open flames. This is decorative lighting
 rather than a replacement for room lighting. Furniture and additional styling accessories shown in the images are not included
Set The Colour For Your Occasion: choose the light colour to complement your decorations or the mood of the evening. refresh the look of the same christmas scene without replacing the silhouettes, whether you are preparing for a gathering or enjoying a quiet evening at home
Ten Separate Lamps: the set combines ten individual lamps with a remote control for selecting colours. santa in his sleigh and six reindeer form the upper arrangement, while the trees and small houses below complete the decorative scene
Detailed Silhouette Design: black outlines define the antlers, fir trees and rooftops, with window cut-outs adding detail to the village. lighting behind the shapes highlights their contours against the wall and gives the whole arrangement a distinctive appearance
Arrange The Forest Your Way: position the separate forest sections to suit your available space. the upper sleigh and reindeer arrangement spans approximately 105 cm in the illustrated layout, while the forest measures approximately 80 cm across. allow extra space for your chosen gaps
Decorate Your Indoor Space: for adults styling living rooms, hallways and dining areas for christmas. arrange the scene above a sideboard or on a suitable clear wall to create a decorative focal point while leaving the surface below available for everyday items or other ornaments
Indoor Use

8941467526462.variantName: 24 in Pre Lit Spruce Christmas Wreath 160 Tips 50 Warm White LED Battery Operated with Timer Pine Cones Red Berries
8941467526462.sourceDescription:
A sparkling mixed branch wreath with bristle tips, trimmed with pine cones, red berries and glitter. The artificial branches are individually crafted to look ultra realistic, and 160 branch tips give the wreath a full, natural shape that keeps its form from one Christmas to the next. The mix of bristle tips, cones, berries and glitter adds depth, so the wreath reads well from a distance as well as close up.

The wreath measures 24 inches in diameter and comes pre-strung with 50 battery operated warm white LED lights. The LEDs are energy efficient and long lasting, and an integrated timer keeps them on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours, so the display switches itself on at the same time each evening without you having to think about it. Because the lights run on batteries, the wreath can hang where there is no socket nearby. The needles are fire resistant and non-allergenic.

At 24 inches across it is a mid sized wreath: large enough to hold its own on a front door, and compact enough to hang indoors above a console table or on a hallway wall. The green foliage, berries and glitter suit autumn, winter and Christmas displays, and the soft warm white glow is gentle enough for an entrance hall or a living room. Store it carefully after the season and the shape and lights will be ready for the following December.

Three multicoloured metal flowers, each around 35 x 15 cm, with hollow-cut petals and leaves that give them proper dimension once they're up. The mix of colours means they'll tie in with a room that already has a few things going on rather than fighting them.

They're pressed from smooth-coated metal, so they're waterproof and hard-wearing — a bathroom, kitchen or dining room is no trouble at all. The size is generous enough to make a feature of a plain wall without swamping a smaller room.

Glue dots come in the pack, so there's nothing to drill and nothing to fill in later; just peel and press them on. Hang all three together or spread them about. A nice, easy bit of colour for a living room, bedroom or hallway, and a decent gift for someone who's just moved.

Weight: 272 g | Material: Powder-coated metal
Three multicoloured metal wall flowers
Hollow petal design gives a 3D finish
Set of three, each piece 35 x 15 cm
Waterproof and durable coated metal
Glue dots included, no tools required
Guarantee - 1 month

5056797098862.variantName: MySmartBuy 120cm LED Silhouette Christmas Tree with Stand, Outdoor Light
5056797098862.sourceDescription:
Create a striking festive display with this metal silhouette Christmas tree from MySmartBuy. Measuring 90.5 x 120cm, it is lit with 420 green and white micro LEDs that trace the classic tree shape. It comes with a stand, so it can be displayed free-standing on lawns, patios and pathways. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer takes care of switching it on and off, for effortless seasonal lighting. Ground spikes are included to hold it securely on lawns, in borders and beside pathways. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: 90.5 x 120cm silhouette tree | 420 green and white micro LEDs | stand | ground spikes included | 5m lead cable | timer | outdoor use.
90.5 x 120CM SILHOUETTE TREE : 420 green and white micro LEDs trace the classic tree shape.
FREE-STANDING : Supplied with a stand for lawns, patios and pathways.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
BUILT-IN TIMER : Takes care of switching on and off for effortless seasonal lighting.
OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAY : Gardens, porches, pathways and entrances.

5063536180962.sourceDescription:
Embrace the festive season with this charming wooden LED Advent Calendar, a delightful addition to any home decor. Unlike traditional countdowns, this piece features a quaint miniature box design adorned with a beautiful winter scene. It elegantly incorporates two numbered wooden cubes, allowing you to easily adjust the date daily throughout December as you anticipate Christmas Day. The calendar's free-flowing design and warm wooden finish make it a timeless heirloom piece that can be enjoyed year after year.

This lovely calendar is illuminated by a gentle, warm white glow, thanks to the five integrated LED lights. These lights cast a cozy ambiance on the surrounding winter landscape, perfectly enhancing the Christmas atmosphere in any room. To simplify the setup and keep the calendar neat, it is battery-operated, requiring just 2xAAA batteries (not included). The subtle illumination ensures the calendar stands out as an eye-catching decoration even on the darkest winter nights.

Adding to the seasonal cheer, the top of the calendar is decorated with festive, charming figures, creating a complete and heartwarming miniature scene. While the core design is consistent, featuring a beautiful winter setting, there are three variations available, each sent out at random. These variations include a choice of popular Christmas-related slogans such as "Merry Christmas", "Let it Snow", or "Happy Holidays", ensuring a lovely surprise upon arrival.

Measuring approximately H14 x W11 x D9 cm, this wooden LED Advent Calendar is the perfect size for placement on a mantelpiece, shelf, or side table without taking up too much space. Its compact yet detailed nature makes it an excellent gift or a wonderful treat for yourself, guaranteed to spread Christmas magic throughout your home. Start a new, beautiful tradition of counting down the days to Christmas with this enchanting decoration.

• Wooden Advent Calendar with two numbered cubes.

• Warm white light from 5 integrated LEDs.
5 integrated LEDs
Includes 20 pots of multi-coloured dough
Comes with 42 tools, cutters, stamps, and moulds
Dough pot lids double as fun animal/shape stamps
Encourages creative, sensory, and imaginative play
Helps develop fine motor skills
Box Dimensions: 39cm L x 24cm W x 7cm H
Ideal gift set for children
Guarantee - 1 month

5096042275662.variantName: Christmas wreath - Seasonal wall wreath - Brown and gold baubles for hanging on a door or wall - Brown, gold and green, 50 cm
5096042275662.sourceDescription:
Brown baubles and pine cones bring warm woodland tones to this handmade wreath. Gold details catch the light between the green sprigs, making it easy to pick up either the natural or the metallic side of the design elsewhere in the room. At 50 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

Curved bauble surfaces reflect the colours immediately around them. Try hanging the wreath where it catches a little daylight and leave space in front of the decorations to show the different surfaces. When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct. For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards.

To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree.
Handmade Christmas wreath featuring brown and gold baubles with pine cones for a warm woodland aesthetic.
Compact 50 cm diameter design ideal for hanging on doors or walls without occupying excessive space.
Gold accents catch the light between green sprigs, adding a subtle metallic touch to seasonal decor.
Complete one-piece outline ensures easy positioning and display in entrances or above mantelpieces.
Comes with None

5058194828462.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal character to your home decor.
Versatile decorative accessory designed to create a focal point for Christmas displays.
Durable plastic construction ensures longevity and easy maintenance for repeated seasonal use.
Single item pack provides a simple finishing touch to coordinate with other holiday decorations.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Festive Battery-Operated Lit Firefly Wreath

Bring light to any area of your home with the stylish Festive Battery-Operated Lit Firefly Wreath


Product details


The Festive Battery-Operated Lit Firefly Wreath is a captivating and versatile decoration that will add a touch of magic to any home. With its lush green foliage and twinkling warm white LED lights, this enchanting wreath creates an inviting atmosphere that is sure to delight family and friends.

One of the standout features of this wreath is its unique firefly lighting effect. Every other bulb on the wreath flickers gently, creating a mesmerising shimmer that mimics the soft glow of real candles. This enchanting effect adds a touch of warmth and nostalgia to the festive season, making it the perfect way to create a cosy and inviting atmosphere in your home.

The Festive Lit Firefly Wreath is also incredibly convenient and easy to set up. Simply insert 3 x AA batteries, switch it on and hang the wreath on a door, wall or mantelpiece. The battery-operated design gives you the freedom to place the wreath anywhere in your home without having to worry about finding a nearby power outlet.

The wreath’s compact size and lightweight design make it easy to move around and store away after Christmas is over. All you will need to do is remove the batteries and store it in a weather-proof location until next year. The perfect way to add a touch of Christmas cheer to your home.

Whether you’re looking for a festive centre-piece for your front door or a charming decoration for your living room, this enchanting wreath is sure to bring joy and wonder to everyone who sees it. With its realistic appearance, captivating lighting effect, and convenient battery-operated design, the Festive Lit Firefly Wreath is the ideal choice for all your Christmas decorating needs.

Product details


Diameter: 60cm
LED colour: warm white
Bulb style: firefly – every other bulb flickers to create a gentle shimmer
Battery not included

 Our pre-lit Christmas garland boasts realistic frosted pine branches decorated with natural pinecones and bright red berries, creating classic snowy winter festive vibes.

This animated Father Christmas figure stands an impressive 120 cm tall, creating a striking visual focal point for any festive setting. The swaying body motion combined with cheerful music transforms ordinary spaces into lively holiday highlights.

This responsive functionality adds a layer of fun and surprise to seasonal gatherings and celebrations.

Crafted from selected polyester fabric, the traditional red suit offers durability and fade resistance for lasting seasonal use. The detailed accessories include a golden gift box with a red velvet bow and a shoulder sack filled with pine branches and candy canes. These elements enhance the authentic charm and festive appeal of the decoration.

Battery-powered operation using three AA batteries allows for flexible placement without reliance on electrical outlets. This cord-free design ensures safety and convenience when positioning the figure near Christmas trees, doorways, or commercial lobbies. The lightweight construction at 1.9 kg makes it easy to move and arrange as desired.

A sturdy 2 mm thick metal framework provides internal stability, ensuring the figure remains upright during movement. Handcrafted details contribute to an exquisite finish that stands out among other holiday ornaments.

The bridge measures 39 cm wide, 33 cm high and just 4 cm deep, so the slim profile fits narrow shelves and ledges. A balanced base keeps it steady on flat surfaces.

It is battery operated and needs 2 x AA batteries (not included), so there are no cables or sockets to plan around and you can place it wherever you like indoors.
7 WARM WHITE LED CANDLES: Features seven warm white LED lights to create a soft, festive glow for your Christmas display.
DECORATIVE SNOWFLAKE DESIGN: The wooden candle bridge features decorative snowflake detailing, adding seasonal character to your Christmas decorations.
NATURAL WOODEN APPEARANCE: Made from wood with a natural-style finish, this candle arch brings a traditional decorative look to your festive setting.
CORDLESS BATTERY OPERATION: Powered by 2 x AA batteries (not included), allowing flexible placement without a mains power connection.
SUITABLE FOR TABLETOP DISPLAY: Approximately 39cm wide and 33cm high, making it suitable for display on a mantelpiece, windowsill, shelf or table.
Guarantee - 1 month
Power source: Battery-powered
Suitable for Indoor use

Integrated LED and fibre optic lights create sparkling points of light around the sleigh and across the night sky, bringing the festive scene to life when the room is dim. Measuring approximately 40cm wide by 50cm high, it creates an eye-catching seasonal focal point without taking up floor space. Powered by 3 x AA batteries (not included), the artwork can be hung without needing a nearby mains socket or trailing cable. An inviting way to add a magical glow to your festive evenings.

Enjoy a richly detailed winter illustration featuring snowy rooftops, frosted trees, a church spire and warm window lights, all finished with a clean white frame for a classic festive look.

Norway Spruce has the unmistakable shape of a traditional Christmas tree, with dark green foliage, a neat conical outline, and branches that angle upwards to create a naturally attractive silhouette. The stiff, pointed needles give it a distinctly spruce-like appearance, while the strong branches provide plenty of support for your favourite decorations. A strong pine fragrance completes the experience, bringing the familiar scent of a real Christmas tree into the home.
STRONG, UPWARD-FACING BRANCHES: The branches of Norway Spruce angle upwards to create its characteristic Christmas-tree shape, while their strength provides good support for lights, baubles, and other decorations. The natural spacing also allows the shape of the tree to remain visible once it is decorated.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE WITH A PINE SCENT: Norway Spruce has the distinctive fragrance associated with traditional spruce trees, adding a natural Christmassy scent to the room that adds to the magic of the season.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: Once the festive period is over, move the tree outdoors where it can continue growing. Its evergreen foliage provides year-round colour, making it suitable for inclusion among evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE WITH ROOM TO DEVELOP: The container provides a practical way to keep the tree growing while it is still young, without committing immediately to a permanent planting position. These live potted Christmas trees can therefore be enjoyed as Christmas trees while also being given the opportunity to become a long-term feature in the garden.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
